issue_context.title: `gh gist view` and `gh gist edit` prompts with no TTY
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug `gh gist view` and `gh gist edit` attempt to prompt when no TTY is available, but it should not. It should behave more like `gh run view`, for example:
Example `gh run view` behavior with no TTY

``` ❯ gh run view | cat run or job ID required when not running interactively Usage: gh run view [] [flags] Flags: -a, --attempt uint The attempt number of the workflow run --exit-status Exit with non-zero status if run failed -j, --job string View a specific job ID from a run -q, --jq expression Filter JSON output using a jq expression --json fields Output JSON with the specified fields --log View full log for either a run or specific job --log-failed View the log for any failed steps in a run or specific job -t, --template string Format JSON output using a Go template; see "gh help formatting" -v, --verbose Show job steps -w, --web Open run in the browser ```

### Steps to reproduce the behavior `gh gist view | cat` ### Expected vs actual behavior Expected: `gh gist view` and `gh gist edit` should return an error & "help" output if no TTY is available when it would otherwise prompt. Actual: `gh gist view` and `gh gist edit` attempts to prompt the user ### Logs ``` ❯ gh gist view | cat ? Select a gist [Use arrows to move, type to filter] > test.md test gist about 19 hours ago draft.md about 2 months ago ```
comments: I'd like to try this one after triage is complete :) thanks!

👋 Hey @mateusmarquezini, thanks for your interest in taking this! ✨ 

> ... after triage is complete 

Yes please! ❤  After our first responder person has had a chance to triage this, and assuming they agree, you will be good to carry on with your PR 😁

@BagToad : oof, yeah this is definitely a bug. 🤔 

**Any sense of how big of a problem it is for other `gh gist` commands**?

- [`gh gist clone`](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/trunk/pkg/cmd/gist/clone/clone.go) doesn't prompt users
- [`gh gist create`](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/trunk/pkg/cmd/gist/create/create.go) doesn't prompt users
- [`gh gist delete`](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/trunk/pkg/cmd/gist/delete/delete.go) doesn't appear to prompt user for deleting the gist, which seems like an oversight maybe

  ```shell
  $ gh gist delete 6ade52369ccd7a37c9ed3c24202abf54
  $
  ```

- [`gh gist edit`](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/trunk/pkg/cmd/gist/edit/edit.go) seems like it prompts the user for a gist if not provided on the command line

  ```shell
  $ gh gist edit | cat
  ? Select a gist  [Use arrows to move, type to filter]
  > README.md github/gh-skyline feedback about 2 days ago
    .dockerfile  about 4 days ago
    README.md  about 1 month ago
    README.md Interesting GitHub CLI `gh api` use cases about 3 months ago
    README.md `gh models` feedback about 3 months ago
    README.md FFXIV about 5 months ago
    HUG.md Human User Guides about 6 months ago
  ```
  
https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/46bba45fac8cbd79cefea26f2413319ed15ddf5d/pkg/cmd/gist/edit/edit.go#L94-L121

- [`gh gist list`](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/trunk/pkg/cmd/gist/list/list.go) doesn't prompt users
- [`gh gist rename`](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/trunk/pkg/cmd/gist/rename/rename.go) doesn't prompt users
- [`gh gist view`](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/trunk/pkg/cmd/gist/view/view.go) prompts as you found ✨ 

### Questions

1. **Should this issue make sure both `gh gist edit` and `gh gist view` only prompt if interactive?**

1. **Should `gh gist delete` prompt before deleting?**

> Should this issue make sure both `gh gist edit` and `gh gist view` only prompt if interactive?

Good catch @andyfeller  👍  I think yes.

Edit: I've updated the PR title and description to reflect this information.

> Should `gh gist delete` prompt before deleting?

This seems like it might be worth discussing more in another different issue, if we want to do this 🤔 

I think we want to consider this more deeply on its own since adding a prompt here could be seen as "breaking". We might want to also consider and discus what happens to that prompt with no TTY - do we also add a `--yes` flag for alignment with other delete commands.
@andyfeller bump - can we unblock this issue for @mateusmarquezini please?

> [@andyfeller](https://github.com/andyfeller) bump - can we unblock this issue for [@mateusmarquezini](https://github.com/mateusmarquezini) please?

@BagToad : Thanks for the nudge!  Let's see about getting some acceptance criteria drawn up here momentarily to unblock this and create a separate issue for the missing confirmation work. 👍

## Acceptance Criteria

**When** I run `gh gist view` non-interactively to edit a gist without gist ID or URL
**Then** I see an informative error and receive an exit code of `1`

```shell
gist ID or URL required when not running interactively
```

---

**When** I run `gh gist edit` non-interactively to edit a gist without gist ID or URL
**Then** I see an informative error and receive an exit code of `1`

```shell
gist ID or URL required when not running interactively
```

---

**When** I run `gh gist edit -a <filename> <source file>` non-interactively to add a new file to the gist from a local source file without gist ID or URL as the first argument
**Then** I see an informative error and receive an exit code of `1`

```shell
gist not found: <source file>
```

> [!NOTE]
> For example, see [`gh run view` behavior](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/40984d1eb6a3fb75df22da8eb5a5414c40c6d245/pkg/cmd/run/view/view.go#L155-L160)
@mateusmarquezini : you're all cleared!  thank you for your patience with holiday delays 🙇
Thank you @andyfeller ! No worries at all, it's always a pleasure! The changes are ready for review. Please, let me know if anything needs improvements. Cheers!

review_comments: This was needed to properly test interactivity in the case of "no gist selector provided" because when that happens a list of gists is fetched and we need the HTTP and selector mocks for that request.
Aligned as closely to `gist view` tests as possible 😃
When we have a selector provided, we expect the command to fetch that gist. If the test has defined a mock gist, then we return that. Otherwise we consider that a 404 and return that instead.
